Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner finalized the answer as “Yes” by implicitly selecting the 2005 film Boogeyman (directed by Stephen Kay) without definitively disambiguating which “Boogeyman (film)” the question referred to. Other films commonly referred to as “Boogeyman/The Boogeyman” (e.g., 1980 by Ulli Lommel, 2023 by Rob Savage) have non-American directors, which would change the answer to “No.” The premature resolution of this ambiguity led to a potentially incorrect conclusion.
